body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics introduced TV-based Bluetooth solution ''WiseLink'' during CES 2007. With Bluetooth headset users can listen to the sound wirelessly as watching TV and they can also print pictures being seen on the TV wirelessly without the need for a pc.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
